testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: What clients who trusted me have to say

items.name: Ahcen B.
items.content: We've been using his SaaS at the clinic for a few weeks and it saves us an incredible amount of time every day. Sofiane immediately understood the reality of our work, and he fixed the small feedback points incredibly fast during the testing phase. In short, clean and efficient work.

items.name: Sarah M.
items.content: Our old site was slow and we were losing sales on mobile. Sofiane rebuilt us a shop that's ultra fast, smooth and really easy for the team to manage day to day. Our customers' feedback is great and the checkout flow is finally perfect.

items.name: Karim O.
items.project: Consulting web app with real-time messaging
items.content: It's rare to find a fullstack dev who grasps what you want so quickly without needing a 50-page spec document. The real-time messaging runs smoothly, deadlines were met and post-delivery support was there.
